notes: First microwave cavity light-shining-through-a-wall (LSW) experiment searching for hidden sector photons (dark photons). The paper reports an upper limit on kinetic mixing parameter χ = 2.9 × 10^-5 at a hidden sector photon mass of 37.78 µeV (= 3.788 × 10^-5 eV). The authors acknowledge this result lies within already-established limits but validates the microwave cavity LSW concept. The experiment used two cylindrical copper cavities (radius ~2 cm, length ~4 cm) in the TE_0_1_1 mode at ~9.588 GHz. The main limitation was microwave leakage in the common vacuum chamber. The paper discusses future improvements that could reduce the χ limit by several orders of magnitude. The coupling type is DarkPhoton (kinetic mixing χ between photon and hidden sector photon), not AxionPhoton, as the paper explicitly discusses hidden sector photons and kinetic mixing rather than axion-photon coupling. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.85, 1))
